name: customdomain
description: Connect a custom domain to an app with DNS and HTTPS handled for you, and diagnose one that is not live.

interface.longDescription: Connect a domain you own to your app. CustomDomain™ works out the DNS records, issues the HTTPS certificate and serves the traffic. It also checks whether a domain is live, fixes one that is not, and sets up email records and redirects. Ask in plain words, sign in once, and approve any change that matters before it happens.
capabilities: Connect a domain to an app
Check whether a domain is live
Diagnose a domain that is not working
Set up email records and redirects
defaultPrompt: Why is my domain not live yet?
Set up email records for my domain.

positive.prompt: List the domains connected to my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a plain list of the domains connected to the signed in workspace with each one's status.

positive.description: Find where a domain's DNS is hosted
positive.prompt: Where is the DNS for example.com hosted, and how would you connect it?
positive.expected_behavior: Name the DNS provider for the domain and describe the setup route it supports, without changing anything.

positive.description: Connect a subdomain to an app
positive.expected_behavior: Find the DNS provider, start the connection, and return the records to add or the setup link exactly as the tool gave them.

positive.description: Check whether a domain is live
positive.prompt: Is app.example.com live and is its certificate valid?
positive.expected_behavior: Report whether the domain is live and whether its HTTPS certificate is issued and valid.

positive.description: Diagnose a domain that is not working
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the issue that blocks the domain in plain words and the next step to fix it.

negative.description: Buying a domain is not offered
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call. Reply plainly that buying domains and API keys are handled in the CustomDomain™ console.
No tool call. Reply plainly that buying domains and API keys are handled in the CustomDomain™ console.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Minneapolis?
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call. Reply plainly that this is outside what the plugin does, which is connecting a domain you own to your app.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.1: Narrowed to connecting a domain you own to your app, checking and fixing it, and setting up email records and redirects. Skills now use only the tools the ChatGPT profile offers. Buying domains, plans and workspace admin (keys, members, webhooks) are handled in the CustomDomain™ console, and the plugin points to no billing page. Developer name is CustomDomain™ and the category is Developer Tools. Privacy, terms and support links updated. The three negative test cases now state the expected behavior: no tool call and a plain reply.
